comment: Pinned dependency and toolchain metadata for the LUMEN P0 native foundation. The CPU and mock backends must build without a vendor NPU SDK.

policy.toolchain_resolution: host system toolchain selected through CMake presets; target builds use cmake/toolchains/*.cmake

host_targets.note: CTest coverage is host-only in P0; target hardware evidence belongs to the NPU qualification work item.

development_only.evidence_validator: scripts/qualification/validate_evidence.py uses only the Python 3 standard library and is not shipped, linked, or required by the runtime or model packer

qualification_harness.synthetic_profile: tests/qualification/data/synthetic-target-profile.json is harness input only and is never device evidence
